{"id":1851843494,"question_id":3864,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 1 week","timestamp":1765356269,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1851843494/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count the Number of Computer Unlocking Permutations","memory":"92.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n    long long factorial(long long n)\n    {\n        long long fact = 1;\n        for(int i=1 ; i<=n ; i++) fact = (fact * i) % mod;\n        return fact;\n    }\n\n    int countPermutations(vector<int>& complexity) {\n        int n = complexity.size();\n\n        int mini = INT_MAX;        \n        for(int i=1 ; i<complexity.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            //agar aage koi computer hai jo unlock kr sakta h sbko to usse he unlock krva lo\n            mini = min(mini , complexity[i]);\n        }\n\n        return (mini > complexity[0]) ? factorial(n-1) : 0;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-the-number-of-computer-unlocking-permutations","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1301}
